units.source_text: 却说当年有一位藤壶女御，是已故左大臣之女。

en.t: Now, in those days there was a Fujitsubo lady-in-waiting, the daughter of the late Minister of the Left.

units.source_text: 今上还当太子时，她首先入宫为太子妃，因此今上特别宠爱她。

en.t: When the present emperor was still crown prince, she was the first to enter the palace as his consort, and for that reason he loved her especially dearly.

units.source_text: 然而这宠爱终于不曾使她立为皇后，空度了若干岁月。

en.t: Yet even this favor never led to her being made empress, and many years passed in vain.

units.source_text: 其间明石女御当了正宫，生了许多皇子，个个长大成人。

en.t: In the meantime, the Akashi lady became the principal consort, bore many imperial princes, and every one of them grew to adulthood.

units.source_text: 而这位藤壶女御生育稀少，只有一位皇女，人称为二公主。

en.t: This Fujitsubo lady, however, had few children and only one imperial princess, known to people as the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 藤壶女御被后来入宫的明石女御所压倒，自恨命苦，不胜悲伤。

en.t: The Fujitsubo lady was overshadowed by the Akashi lady, who had entered the palace later, and grieving over her own unhappy fate, she was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 为欲补偿此缺憾，至少希望这女儿前程荣达，亦可稍慰初心。

en.t: Wanting to make up for this disappointment, she hoped at least that her daughter would have a brilliant future, which would somewhat comfort her original hopes.

units.source_text: 因此悉心教养这二公主，不遗余力。

en.t: For this reason, she devoted herself completely to raising and educating the Second Princess, sparing no effort.
